errors.says: Multiplying a target address field by a unit modulo q^b costs O(V) when the controls precede the target.
errors.paper: Lemma lem:ordered-affine-streams gives O(V) only for multiplication by one of finitely many fixed rational units whose numerators and denominators are prime to q, and for offset updates only if the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time; the cost of multiplying by c grows with the number c of pieces.

errors.says: Packed selected-bit addition costs O(V(L^tau+1)), stated with no hypotheses.
errors.paper: The lemma's bound is O(V(L^tau+1)+MA^3+delta_bad MA(R+A)); it reduces to O(V(L^tau+1)) only when A=O(p), R is superpolynomial in p, f<=d<=p and K/log p->infinity.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route end to end. It covers the bank-exchange network, frames, labels and the rational interface (s_b<W_b m), then the matrix shear, the power-width recurrence and the arbitrary-width interchange. The butterfly layer comes next (phase frames, packed XORs, recurrence and guard bits), followed by synthetic transforms and convolution, resampling with the permutations retained, the chirp and its cancellation, CRT and twist, assembly, exact recovery and the cost table giving kappa=2^-182. It thins out at the labels and at the complex interface. The label construction itself (stage transitions, gate-label and residual tables) is only asserted. The complex phase interface is used without its frame definition, its count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, or the endpoint result C^{tensor m} on every role. The network's fixed parameters h=100, N=C(100,3)^3 and m=10^6 are never given.

steps.note: The exchange (x,y)->(-y,x) with restored scratch and the triple-intersection gates are reconstructed. But h=100, the indexing of X_a, Y_a by triples a in T^3, N=C(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never given (N and m appear only as 'data wires per bank' and 'label dimension'), so conservatively this is not a full reconstruction of the fixed network.
A common invertible frame per vertex commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge only changes frame.

Nondegenerate labels in an m-dimensional space built from triple indicators, comparable on every edge, with only the centre 3->4 edges decreasing by h. F^{tensor 3} is not named and the label tables are not given.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, with the N first X_a edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the only exceptions.
Signed sum Wm-2N, L=Ich, absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, then s_b=W_b m-2N+2L_b+N=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_b m.
The endpoint difference is P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m on X_a and I-0 elsewhere, so every route applies Phi_{I_m}, i.e. H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones in Pi, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and a node therefore makes s recursive calls in all.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), tau=1-2^-50 from eta>20*2^-50 and log m<20, and the geometric sum giving F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: Eight of the nine steps are reconstructed. The chain from frames, labels and rank-equals-dimension through the budget Wm-2N+2L, the ratio 100/539<1/2, the endpoint identity, rank-many interchanges and the recurrence to tau=1-2^-50 is carried with its quantities. C1 is only mentioned: the bank-exchange mechanism is there, but the fixed parameters h=100, N=C(h,3)^3 and m=h^3, and the triple indexing of the data, are absent.
